name: Research Source Review
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds local source paragraph pins, manual scans and comparisons before approval.
Adds named groups and dated local reports through GitHub Sponsors Pro.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Settings now have a More from NoteMods group, with a switch that turns this tab off.
tip: Run Scan saved pins to check for changed source paragraphs.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Research Source Review is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
